DSPSC.description: PSC Design Code (DSPSC). The only field is the design code name, which OnSet enforces to be exactly "AASHTO-LRFD24".

DGNCODE.description: Design code name. OnSet throws LV_WRONG_FIELD unless this equals "AASHTO-LRFD24"; on GET other codes may be read back but only "AASHTO-LRFD24" can be set.
